title: decaloba biflora
intro: Decaloba biflora, commonly known as Mexican prickle poppy, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. The Mexican prickle poppy is a flowering plant that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Decaloba biflora include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Decaloba biflora include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
